package gateways

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Channel acknowledges each heartbeat a signed gateway sends over its job
// channel. The tenant and subject come only from the verified machine.
func Channel(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports ChannelPorts,
	in models.ChannelRequest,
	stream scope.Stream[models.Beat, models.Ack],
) error {
	_ = in

	for {
		beat, err := stream.Receive(ctx)
		if errors.Is(err, scope.ErrStreamClosed) {
			return nil
		}

		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		ack, err := ports.Registry.Beat(ctx, e, beat)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if err := stream.Send(ctx, ack); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}
